順番どおりにつなげると元の APK になります (中身をそのまま後ろにつなげるだけ)。

  BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part0  (先頭)
  BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part1  (続き)

つなげ方:
  Linux / Mac / Termux:  cat BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part0 BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part1 > BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk
  Windows (cmd):         copy /b BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part0+BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk.part1 BionicRunner-1.38.0.apk
